-- ARAM_EXPLOITS.lua
-- Full standalone LocalScript for Roblox Studio
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- Features: Blue UI, draggable window, A button, ESP, Speed slider, NoClip,
-- Floating AIMBOT [MMB], target lock until 0 HP, ignore Rat & RatCriminal.

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS=game:GetService("RunService")
local VIM=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera

-- =========================
-- ONE-SCRIPT KEY SYSTEM
-- =========================
-- Local-only key check. This is convenient for a single-script setup,
-- but it is NOT secure against someone inspecting the LocalScript.
local VALID_KEY="ARAM-2026"
local LINK="https://link-hub.net/4890633/YHGbs3YoPMqL"
local keyVerified=false

local function createKeySystem(parentGui,onUnlocked)

 local title=Instance.new("TextLabel",keyFrame)

 title.TextSize=24

 subtitle.Text="KEY SYSTEM"
 subtitle.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham

 subtitle.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(160,160,170)

 local box=Instance.new("TextBox",keyFrame)
 box.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,44)
 box.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,84)
 box.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,40)
 box.BorderSizePixel=0
 box.ClearTextOnFocus=false
 box.PlaceholderText="Enter key..."
 box.Text=""
 box.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
 box.TextSize=16
 box.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 box.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(100,100,110)
 box.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
 Instance.new("UICorner",box).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)
 local getKey=Instance.new("TextButton",keyFrame)
 getKey.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,42)
 getKey.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,138)
 getKey.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,160,255)
 getKey.BorderSizePixel=0
 getKey.Text="GET KEY"
 getKey.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 getKey.TextSize=15
 getKey.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 Instance.new("UICorner",getKey).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)


 local unlock=Instance.new("TextButton",keyFrame)
 unlock.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,42)
 unlock.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,186)
 unlock.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,170,40)
 unlock.BorderSizePixel=0
 unlock.Text="UNLOCK"
 unlock.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 unlock.TextSize=15
 unlock.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 Instance.new("UICorner",unlock).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)

 local status=Instance.new("TextLabel",keyFrame)
 status.BackgroundTransparency=1
 status.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,234)
 status.Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,24)
 status.Text="Enter your key"
 status.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
 status.TextSize=12
 status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(190,190,200)

 local function tryUnlock()
  if box.Text==VALID_KEY then
   keyVerified=true
   status.Text="KEY ACCEPTED"
   status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,210,100)
   task.wait(0.15)
   keyFrame.Visible=false
   if onUnlocked then
    onUnlocked()
   end
   return true
  else
   status.Text="INVALID KEY"
   status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,70,70)
   box.Text=""
   box:CaptureFocus()
   return false
  end
 end

 getKey.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  local opened=false

  pcall(function()
   local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
   if GuiService and typeof(GuiService.OpenBrowserWindow)=="function" then
    GuiService:OpenBrowserWindow(LINK)
    opened=true
   end
  end)

  pcall(function()
   if setclipboard then
    setclipboard(LINK)
   end
  end)

  if opened then
   status.Text="Link opened! Complete Linkvertise to get your key."
  else
   status.Text=LINK
  end

  status.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,210,255)
 end)

 unlock.MouseButton1Click:Connect(tryUnlock)

 box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
  if enterPressed then
   tryUnlock()
  end
 end)

 -- Allow the key window to be moved with a mouse or finger.
 local dragging=false
 local dragStart=nil
 local startPos=nil

 keyFrame.Active=true

 keyFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
  if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
     or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   dragging=true
   dragStart=i.Position
   startPos=keyFrame.Position
  end
 end)

 UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
  if dragging
     and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
       or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
   local d=i.Position-dragStart
   keyFrame.Position=UDim2.new(
    startPos.X.Scale,
    startPos.X.Offset+d.X,
    startPos.Y.Scale,
    startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y
   )
  end
 end)

 UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
  if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
     or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   dragging=false
  end
 end)

 return keyFrame
end

-- Responsive UI sizing
local BASE_UI_WIDTH=720
local MIN_UI_SCALE=0.65
local MAX_UI_SCALE=1.35

local function updateResponsiveUI()
 local scale=math.clamp(
  frame.AbsoluteSize.X/BASE_UI_WIDTH,
  MIN_UI_SCALE,
  MAX_UI_SCALE
 )

 -- Keep the two columns balanced as the menu is resized.
 leftColumn.Size=UDim2.new(0.49,-5,1,0)
 rightColumn.Position=UDim2.new(0.51,5,0,0)
 rightColumn.Size=UDim2.new(0.49,-5,1,0)

 -- Switch rows.
 for _,btn in ipairs({espBtn,aimBtn,autoBiteBtn,noclipBtn}) do
  local cardFrame=btn.Parent
  if cardFrame then
   cardFrame.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,50*scale)
   btn.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(70*scale,30*scale)
   btn.Position=UDim2.new(1,-80*scale,.5,-15*scale)

   local label=cardFrame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
   if label then
    label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15*scale,0)
    label.TextSize=16*scale
   end
  end
 end

 -- Speed row.
 speedCard.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,75*scale)
 speedText.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15*scale,8*scale)
 speedText.Size=UDim2.new(1,-30*scale,0,20*scale)
 speedText.TextSize=16*scale

 bar.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15*scale,42*scale)
 bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-30*scale,0,10*scale)

 fill.Size=UDim2.new(fill.Size.X.Scale,0,1,0)

 knob.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(18*scale,18*scale)
 knob.Position=UDim2.new(fill.Size.X.Scale,-9*scale,.5,-9*scale)

 -- Action rows.
 for _,cardFrame in ipairs({cheeseCard,keycardCard,escapedRatCard,scientistCard}) do
  if cardFrame then
   cardFrame.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,50*scale)
  end
 end

 for _,btn in ipairs({cheeseBtn,keycardBtn,escapedRatBtn,scientistBtn}) do
  btn.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10*scale,5*scale)
  btn.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20*scale,1,-10*scale)
  btn.TextSize=(btn==escapedRatBtn or btn==scientistBtn) and 13*scale or 15*scale
 end

 -- TELEPORT heading.
 teleportHeader.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,24*scale)
 teleportSection.TextSize=18*scale
 teleportWarning.TextSize=11*scale
end

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
 if resizing
    and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
      or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

  local d=i.Position-resizeStart

  local newWidth=math.clamp(
   startSize.X+d.X,
   280,
   math.max(300,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X-20)
  )

  local newHeight=math.clamp(
   startSize.Y+d.Y,
   300,
   math.max(350,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y-20)
  )

  frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(newWidth,newHeight)
  updateResponsiveUI()
 end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
 if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
  resizing=false
 end
end)

-- Speed slider
local sliding=false
local speedConnections={}

local function disconnectSpeedConnections()
 for _,connection in ipairs(speedConnections) do
  if connection then
   connection:Disconnect()
  end
 end
 table.clear(speedConnections)
end

local function applySpeed(h)
 if h and h.Parent then
  h.WalkSpeed=speedValue
 end
end

local function setupHumanoidSpeed(c)
 disconnectSpeedConnections()

 local h=c:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

 -- Apply the saved value immediately after spawning.
 applySpeed(h)

 -- Keep the selected value when something in the game changes WalkSpeed.
 -- This is for the user's own game; the server should still be the authority
 -- for any intended gameplay limits.
 table.insert(speedConnections,h:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
  if h.WalkSpeed~=speedValue then
   applySpeed(h)
  end
 end))
end

local function updateSpeedSliderFromX(x)
 x=math.clamp(x,0,1)
 speedValue=math.max(1,math.floor(x*100))

 fill.Size=UDim2.new(x,0,1,0)
 knob.Position=UDim2.new(x,-9,.5,-9)
 speedText.Text="Speed : "..speedValue

 local c=player.Character
 local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 applySpeed(h)
end

bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)

local cheeseBusy=false

local function normalizedName(name)
 return string.lower((name or ""):gsub("%s+",""))
end

local function findCheeseTrays()
 local trays={}

 -- Search the whole Workspace instead of only Workspace.Cafeteria.
 -- Some games put the visible "Cheese Tray" objects in nested folders/models.
 for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
  if normalizedName(obj.Name)=="cheesetray" then
   local prompt=obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)

   -- Also check the object's ancestors in case the prompt is attached
   -- to a nearby part/model rather than directly inside the tray.
   if not prompt then
    local parent=obj.Parent
    for _=1,4 do
     if not parent then break end
     prompt=parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
     if prompt then break end
     parent=parent.Parent
    end
   end

   local targetCFrame=nil

   if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
    targetCFrame=obj.CFrame
   elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
    targetCFrame=obj:GetPivot()
   else
    local part=obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
    if part then
     targetCFrame=part.CFrame
    end
   end

   if targetCFrame then
    table.insert(trays,{
     object=obj,
     prompt=prompt,
     cframe=targetCFrame
    })
   end
  end
 end

 return trays
end

 if cheeseBusy then return end

  cheeseBusy=false

 -- if the game creates a visible "Take Tray" button in PlayerGui,

 if not usedMobileButton and prompt and prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then
  pcall(function()
   prompt:InputHoldBegin()

   local holdTime=tonumber(prompt.HoldDuration) or 0
   task.wait(math.max(0.1,holdTime+0.1))

   prompt:InputHoldEnd()
  end)

  task.wait(0.2)
 end

 -- Desktop / keyboard fallback:
 -- the interaction shown in the game uses the F key.
 if not usedMobileButton then
  pcall(function()
   VIM:SendKeyEvent(true,Enum.KeyCode.F,false,game)
   task.wait(0.08)
   VIM:SendKeyEvent(false,Enum.KeyCode.F,false,game)
  end)

  task.wait(0.4)
 end

 -- Return to the exact starting position.
 if root and root.Parent then

 cheeseBusy=false

-- Escaped Rat base teleport
local function findEscapedRatBase()
 -- Exact object name shown in Explorer.
 local exact=workspace:FindFirstChild("EscapedRatSewerGrate",true)
 if exact then
  return exact
 end

 -- Fallback: any object containing EscapedRatSewerGrate in its name.
 for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
  local name=string.lower(obj.Name)
  if string.find(name,"escapedratsewergrate",1,true) then
   return obj
  end
 end

 return nil
end

local function getTeleportCFrame(obj)
 if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
  return obj.CFrame
 elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
  return obj:GetPivot()
 elseif obj:IsA("Attachment") then
  return obj.WorldCFrame
 end

 local parts={}
 for _,desc in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
  if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
   table.insert(parts,desc)
  end
 end

 if #parts==0 then
  return nil
 end

 local minX,maxX=math.huge,-math.huge
 local minY,maxY=math.huge,-math.huge
 local minZ,maxZ=math.huge,-math.huge

 for _,part in ipairs(parts) do
  local half=part.Size*0.5
  local p=part.Position

  minX=math.min(minX,p.X-half.X)
  maxX=math.max(maxX,p.X+half.X)
  minY=math.min(minY,p.Y-half.Y)
  maxY=math.max(maxY,p.Y+half.Y)
  minZ=math.min(minZ,p.Z-half.Z)
  maxZ=math.max(maxZ,p.Z+half.Z)
 end

 return CFrame.new(
  (minX+maxX)*0.5,
  (minY+maxY)*0.5,
  (minZ+maxZ)*0.5
 )
end

-- Scientiest Section teleport
local function cleanName(name)
 return string.lower((name or ""):gsub("%s+",""))
end

local function hasAncestorNamed(obj, wantedNames)
 local current=obj.Parent

 while current do
  local n=cleanName(current.Name)

  for _,wanted in ipairs(wantedNames) do
   if n==wanted then
    return true
   end
  end

  current=current.Parent
 end

 return false
end

local function findScientiestLever()
 -- Find LeverPullDown anywhere in the game first.
 -- Then prefer the one that is actually inside ScientistSection/MouseTrap.
 local candidates={}

 for _,obj in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
  if cleanName(obj.Name)=="leverpulldown" then
   table.insert(candidates,obj)
  end
 end

 -- Best match: LeverPullDown inside ScientistSection.
 for _,obj in ipairs(candidates) do
  if hasAncestorNamed(obj,{"scientistsection","scientiestsection"}) then
   return obj
  end
 end

 -- Second-best match: LeverPullDown inside MouseTrap.
 for _,obj in ipairs(candidates) do
  if hasAncestorNamed(obj,{"mousetrap"}) then
   return obj
  end
 end

 -- Last fallback: if there is only one LeverPullDown, use it.
 if #candidates==1 then
  return candidates[1]
 end

 return nil
end

-- Aimbot: nearest 360°, ignore Rat / Criminal Rat / RatCriminal.
-- Team is checked from Player.Team every time a target is selected and while locked.
local function isIgnoredAimbotTeam(p)
 if not p then return false end

 local teamName=p.Team and p.Team.Name or ""

 -- Normalize the team name so "Criminal Rat", "CriminalRat"
 -- and "RatCriminal" can all be treated as the protected team.
 local normalized=string.lower(teamName):gsub("%s+","")

 return normalized=="rat" or normalized=="criminalrat" or normalized=="ratcriminal"
end

local function closestTarget()
 local c=player.Character
 if not c then return nil end

 local root=c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root then return nil end

 local best,bestDist=nil,math.huge

 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if p~=player and p.Character and not isIgnoredAimbotTeam(p) then
   local hrp=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local head=p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
   local hum=p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

   if hrp and head and hum and hum.Health>0 then
    local d=(root.Position-hrp.Position).Magnitude

    if d<bestDist then
     bestDist=d
     best=p
    end
   end
  end
 end

 return best
end

RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
 if not aimbotEnabled then
  currentTarget=nil
  return
 end

 -- Re-check the locked player's team every frame.
 if currentTarget then
  if isIgnoredAimbotTeam(currentTarget) then
   currentTarget=nil
  else
   local character=currentTarget.Character
   local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   local head=character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")

   if hum and head and hum.Health>0 then
    camera.CFrame=CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position,head.Position)
    return
   end

   currentTarget=nil
  end
 end

 currentTarget=closestTarget()

 if currentTarget and not isIgnoredAimbotTeam(currentTarget) then
  local character=currentTarget.Character
  local head=character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
  local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

  if head and hum and hum.Health>0 then
   camera.CFrame=CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position,head.Position)
  else
   currentTarget=nil
  end
 end
end)

scripts.features:
GirlMaker Hub is a simple Rat Lab script with useful features for moving around the map and finding important things faster.

The script has ESP for players, cheese, weapons, tasks, and prompts. You can also use Speed Boost, High Jump, and NoClip to move around easier.    

There is also Auto-Interact, Anti-AFK, and a teleport menu with many Rat Lab locations like the laboratory, sewer, rat base, yard, escape road, and other areas.    
If you need a simple Rat Lab script with ESP, teleport, speed, NoClip, and Auto-Interact, GirlMaker Hub puts all these features in one menu.
